description: Chart 15 — Venues on the network, inner Melbourne. The zoomed synthesis: venues overlaid on the train + tram routes within the Melbourne frame (lon 144.75–145.35, lat −37.92 to −37.67, ~10,682 venues filtered in-spec), each coloured by whether its nearest stop is within 400 m. This is where the hospitality–transport trend reads cleanest — 'within 400 m' venues trace the tram grid and radial train lines; 'further' venues sit in the gaps between. Proximity, not service. Routes are the light background; the stop mesh is dropped so the venue layer reads. Data: venues_web.csv (filtered) over pt_routes_melbourne.topojson and sa2_melbourne.topojson.

layer.description: Base: inner-Melbourne SA2 boundaries (shared clipped base).
Train + tram routes, Melbourne-clipped, as a light background.
Venue points in the Melbourne frame, coloured by proximity to the nearest stop (≤400 m vs further).

transform.calculate: datum.nearest_stop_distance_m <= 400 ? 'Within 400 m of a stop' : 'Further than 400 m'
